# boomi_data_integration_blueprint_file (Resource)

The YAML content backing a Blueprint (the customer-facing term; the API/code term is "recipe"). Reference this resource's id as a blueprint_resource's file_cross_id. Changing filename or content updates this resource in place (its id is stable) — the API supports PUT unlike the logicode file API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String, Sensitive) Blueprint YAML content. Stored in state; never read back from the API.
- `filename` (String) Display name for the blueprint YAML file (e.g. "github_commits.yaml").

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment this file belongs to. Falls back to the provider-level environment_id. Changing it forces a new file.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cross_id assigned by the API. Reference this in blueprint_resource.file_cross_id.
